metrics.label: Return on Invested Capital
metrics.formula: NOPAT / average invested capital, where NOPAT = EBIT x (1 - effective tax rate) and invested capital = total debt + shareholders' equity - cash.

metrics.label: Earnings Variability
metrics.formula: Standard deviation of return on assets across the last five fiscal years. Lower is better, so the percentile is inverted.

metrics.label: EBIT / EV
metrics.formula: EBIT / enterprise value. The primary value metric (Gray & Carlisle).

metrics.label: FCF / EV
metrics.formula: (Operating cash flow - capital expenditure) / enterprise value.

metrics.label: Growth in Profitability
metrics.formula: GPOA today minus GPOA three fiscal years ago, in percentage points (a change in the ratio, not a growth rate). ROIC-conditioned.

metrics.label: Revenue Growth (3-yr CAGR)
metrics.formula: Three-year compound annual growth rate of revenue. ROIC-conditioned.

metrics.label: Debt / Equity
metrics.formula: Total debt / total shareholders' equity. Null when equity is negative.

metrics.label: Net Debt / EBITDA
metrics.formula: (Total debt - cash) / EBITDA. Null when EBITDA is zero or negative - a negative multiple must never rank as cheap.

metrics.label: Altman Z-score (Z'')
metrics.formula: Z'' = 6.56*X1 + 3.26*X2 + 6.72*X3 + 1.05*X4, the non-manufacturing variant. Safe > 2.6, grey 1.1-2.6, distress < 1.1.
